data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $14.4M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 8 private companies in the sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrow category.

Of the applicable valuation methods, only Stage-Progression can be reliably applied. This method uses total capital raised ($14.4M) as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $29M. Peer-Median valuation is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Drones & Autonomous sector; while five same-sector peers exist globally, none cluster tightly enough by stage or valuation tier to support robust median benchmarking.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to a single method, supports a valuation range of $24M to $33M, with a median point of $29M. This range reflects modest conservative and aggressive case adjustments around the stage-progression baseline. Key uncertainties limiting conviction include the absence of tight peer comparables, the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for this specific sub-sector, and lack of visibility into unit economics or competitive positioning relative to the peer set. A fuller valuation would benefit from operational metrics and market-share assumptions specific to autonomous delivery or inspection workflows.
